paper.title_en: Bondi Four-Momentum Balance in Quantum NSF Classical matching, DKL supermomentum, and quantum energy redistribution
paper.abstract_en: We derive Bondi four-momentum balance between past and future null infinity in the radiative phase space of the null-surface formulation (NSF). Weyl matching at spatial infinity, together with vanishing endpoint News, gives antipodal continuity of the Bondi mass aspect. Its translation projection is independent of the infrared shear term and transforms as a Lorentz four-vector. Bondi evolution relates the incoming and outgoing News fluxes to the timelike endpoint momenta; in the Dominguez--Kozameh--Ludvigsen radiative sector these momenta vanish and the fluxes are equal. On a common radiative Fock domain, unitary conjugation transports the flux observables. Adopting their classical balance as an additional quantum condition yields exclusive four-momentum conservation. We also calculate the outgoing energy expectation without imposing that condition. For an incoming energy eigenstate, the second-generator commutator vanishes diagonally, leaving a second-order coefficient determined by the cubic generator. Direct canonical contractions isolate the contribution connected to all four external legs. For the equal-energy center-of-mass preparation, axial rotational covariance forces the angularly integrated exchange coefficient to vanish under the finite helicity-projection prescription of Part~I. The connected energy defect therefore vanishes through second order. The full expectation (including spectators) and higher-order balance remain open.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在广义相对论基础（渐近对称性、Bondi质量和类光无穷远）的范围内，对Bondi四动量平衡进行了深入的理论推导，将经典Weyl匹配与量子Fock空间观测量的幺正共轭联系起来，并对出射能量期望进行了微扰计算。理论深度高，方法有明确定义，具有原创性，值得一读。
decision.title_zh: 量子NSF经典匹配中的Bondi四动量平衡、DKL超动量与量子能量重分布
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在零曲面表述（NSF）的辐射相空间中，推导了过去与未来类光无穷远之间的Bondi四动量平衡。空间无穷远处的Weyl匹配，加上端点News为零，给出了Bondi质量方面的对跖连续性。其平移投影独立于红外剪切项，并作为Lorentz四矢量变换。Bondi演化将入射和出射News通量与类时端点动量联系起来；在Dominguez--Kozameh--Ludvigsen辐射扇区中，这些动量消失且通量相等。在共同的辐射Fock域上，幺正共轭输运了通量可观测量。采用它们的经典平衡作为附加量子条件，则产生排他性的四动量守恒。我们还计算了不施加该条件时的出射能量期望值。对于入射能量本征态，第二生成元的对易子在对象限上消失，留下由三次生成元确定的二阶系数。直接的正则缩并分离出与全部四条外腿相连的贡献。对于等能质心制备，轴向旋转协变性强制要求角积分交换系数在Part~I的有限螺旋度投影规定下消失。因此，连通能量亏损在二阶以前消失。完整期望值（包括旁观者）和更高阶平衡仍然未决。
